$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a distinctive part of a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The suppliers and their answers are invented. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

replies.Larkspur:
Summary
Larkspur Cloud Archive Ltd hosts the bank's document archive. Tier 1 (clause 1.3: all requirements apply). 7 met, 3 partly met, 7 not met, 0 not answered.

Draft assessment. For review by the third-party risk officer. Not issued.

| # | Requirement | Standard | Supplier's answer | Evidence relied on | Mark | Reason and what the officer should check |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | The supplier holds an independent security certification or audit report dated within the last 12 months. | MTB-STD-041 2.1 | Yes, holds an audit report | Audit report dated 15 September 2025 | not met | 14 months before the case date of 16 November 2026, so older than 12 months. |
| 2 | Customer information is encrypted at rest and in transit. | MTB-STD-041 2.2 | Yes | Extract of the supplier's document | met | Matches the requirement. |
| 3 | Multi-factor authentication is required for every member of the supplier's staff who can reach the bank's information. | MTB-STD-041 2.3 | Administrators only | Access policy extract | partly met | Other staff use a password. |
| 4 | The supplier tells the bank of a security incident that affects the bank within 24 hours of detecting it. | MTB-STD-041 2.4 | Within 72 hours | Service terms 11.2 | not met | 72 hours is longer than 24. |
| 5 | A penetration test at least once a year, critical findings closed within 30 days. | MTB-STD-041 2.5 | Yearly test, 45 days | Penetration test summary, 20 May 2026 | partly met | Yearly test is met. 45 days is longer than 30. |
| 6 | Customer information stays in Meridia unless the bank has agreed otherwise in writing, backups included. | MTB-STD-041 3.1 | Backups in Quenmark | Hosting schedule | not met | No written agreement from the bank is shown. |
| 7 | The supplier lists its sub-processors and tells the bank 30 days before a change. | MTB-STD-041 3.2 | Yes | Extract of the supplier's document | met | Matches the requirement. |
| 8 | Return or deletion of the bank's information within 60 days, with a certificate. | MTB-STD-041 3.3 | Within 90 days | Service terms 20.3 | not met | 90 days is longer than 60. |
| 9 | A business continuity plan tested within the last 12 months. | MTB-STD-041 4.1 | Yes | Extract of the supplier's document | met | Matches the requirement. |
| 10 | Recovery time objective no longer than four hours. | MTB-STD-041 4.2 | 8 hours | Service schedule | not met | 8 hours is longer than four. |
| 11 | Backups are tested at least twice a year. | MTB-STD-041 4.3 | Once a year | Backup procedure | partly met | Less often than twice a year. |
| 12 | The contract gives the bank the right to audit. | MTB-STD-041 5.1 | Yes | Extract of the supplier's document | met | Matches the requirement. |
| 13 | An exit plan is agreed before the service starts. | MTB-STD-041 5.2 | After signing | Contract clause 18 | not met | Not agreed before the service starts. |
| 14 | The contract gives the bank the right to be told of sub-contracting. | MTB-STD-041 5.3 | Yes | Extract of the supplier's document | met | Matches the requirement. |
| 15 | Liability insurance of at least USD 5 million. | MTB-STD-041 5.4 | USD 2 million | Insurance certificate | not met | Below USD 5 million. |
| 16 | Background check for staff who can reach customer information. | MTB-STD-041 6.1 | Yes | Extract of the supplier's document | met | Matches the requirement. |
| 17 | Security training at least once a year. | MTB-STD-041 6.2 | Yes | Extract of the supplier's document | met | Matches the requirement. |

Recommendation: do not recommend approval: requirements 2.1, 2.4, 3.1, 3.3, 4.2, 5.2 and 5.4 are not met. A tier 1 supplier is approved by the Risk Committee, not by the desk (MTB-STD-041 7.4). A requirement that is not met can be accepted only as a recorded exception approved by the Risk Committee, with an end date (7.5).
